description: Compute your life-path number from your name with the Pythagorean system. For entertainment only.

faqs.a: No. Numerology is entertainment, not science — the number has no power over your life or decisions.
A=1, B=2 … I=9, then J=1, K=2 and so on — the values 1–9 repeat through the alphabet. Non-letters are ignored.
11, 22 and 33 are “master numbers” and are not reduced further, following traditional numerology.
faqs.q: Why do 11, 22 and 33 stay as they are?

howto: Each letter is valued A=1 … I=9, repeating.
The total reduces to 1–9 or a master number 11/22/33.
Read what your life-path number says — for fun.
